Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Communication is a human right. We protect your data.

collection.title: 1. Data Ownership
collection.content: Skillio operates completely on-device. We never collect, upload, or share voice recordings or vocabulary grids.

personal.title: 2. Simple Licensing
personal.content: We only require an email to activate licenses. Student and institutional data are never tracked or shared.

usage.title: 3. Minimal Analytics
usage.content: Anonymized local crash telemetry optimizes performance. No profiling, tracking, or ads.

security.title: 4. Local Encryption
security.content: Settings and speech data are encrypted directly on-device. Sync tools use secure, private channels.

rights.title: 5. Instant Deletion
rights.content: You own your voice. Export configurations or erase all data instantly.

thirdParty.title: 6. Caregiver Sync
thirdParty.content: End-to-end encryption restricts board access to authorized caregivers and SLPs.
